description: This file provides an API client for accessing catalog-related endpoints such as skills and lessons in a frontend application. It includes functions for fetching skills, specific skill details by slug, lessons associated with a skill, and individual lessons by ID, with fallback mechanisms for different API endpoints.

methods.name: handleResponse(res)
methods.description: Processes fetch responses, parsing JSON or text, and handles error statuses appropriately.

methods.name: toPageParams(limit = 12, offset = 0)
methods.description: Calculates pagination parameters based on limit and offset.

methods.name: fetchSkills({ category, limit = 12, offset = 0 } = {})
methods.description: Retrieves paginated skills, with optional filtering by category, supporting fallback to legacy endpoint.

methods.name: fetchSkillBySlug(slug)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific skill by its slug, with fallbacks to ID path and searching the skills list.

methods.name: fetchLessonsBySkillSlug(slug)
methods.description: Fetches lessons associated with a given skill slug.

methods.name: fetchLessonById(id, { skillSlug } = {})
methods.description: Retrieves a lesson by ID, with fallback to searching lessons under a given skill slug.

ctags.name: BASE_URL
ctags.pattern: /^const BASE_URL = config.apiBaseUrl; \/\/ Ensure FastAPI CORS allows http:\/\/localhost:3000 with/

ctags.name: fetchSkills
ctags.pattern: /^export async function fetchSkills({ category, limit = 12, offset = 0 } = {}) {$/
